FATAL CLAW ULTRAWIDE (21:9 / 32:9) - INSTALL
============================================

This fix is a UE4SS Lua mod. No game files are modified - UE4SS loads alongside the game
and the mod corrects the cameras at runtime: full-width image, correct field of view,
cutscenes, the gate-teleport zoom and the camera tint overlay.

Tested at 5120x1440 (32:9) on Fatal Claw (Unreal Engine 4.27, Windows build dated
2026-08-26) with the UE4SS experimental build v3.0.1-1152-ge3ba1016. 21:9 runs the same
code with a different aspect ratio (STEP 5) but has not been tested in-game.

Below, <game> means your Fatal Claw install folder (the one containing FatalClaw.exe).


STEP 1 - Install UE4SS (experimental build)
-------------------------------------------
Download the UE4SS EXPERIMENTAL build from:
    https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental-latest

Pick the file named like UE4SS_v3.0.1-1152-ge3ba1016.zip (the tested build; a newer
UE4SS_v3.x-....zip listed there should also work). Not the "zDEV-", "zCustomGameConfigs"
or "zMapGenBP" files.

Do NOT use the stable "v3.0.1" release: it cannot identify this game's engine and never
starts (UE4SS.log ends with "PS scan timed out").

Extract the zip into <game>\FatalClaw\Binaries\Win64\ so that dwmapi.dll and the ue4ss
folder sit next to FatalClaw-Win64-Shipping.exe:

    <game>\FatalClaw\Binaries\Win64\
        FatalClaw-Win64-Shipping.exe
        dwmapi.dll           <- from the zip
        ue4ss\               <- from the zip


STEP 2 - Tell UE4SS the engine version (required)
-------------------------------------------------
Open <game>\FatalClaw\Binaries\Win64\ue4ss\UE4SS-settings.ini, find the
[EngineVersionOverride] section and fill in the two values:

    [EngineVersionOverride]
    MajorVersion = 4
    MinorVersion = 27

Without this, UE4SS fails to identify the engine and the mod never loads.


STEP 3 - Turn off UE4SS's bundled example mods (recommended)
------------------------------------------------------------
UE4SS ships with developer mods (cheat manager, console enabler, Blueprint mod loader,
keybinds and so on). Fatal Claw doesn't need them, and the fix was tested with all of
them off.

In <game>\FatalClaw\Binaries\Win64\ue4ss\Mods\mods.txt set every entry to 0:

    CheatManagerEnablerMod : 0
    ConsoleCommandsMod : 0
    ConsoleEnablerMod : 0
    SplitScreenMod : 0
    LineTraceMod : 0
    BPML_GenericFunctions : 0
    BPModLoaderMod : 0
    Keybinds : 0

The same folder also has a mods.json: set every "mod_enabled" in it to false.


STEP 4 - Install the mod
------------------------
Copy the UltrawideFix folder (next to this file) into ue4ss\Mods\:

    <game>\FatalClaw\Binaries\Win64\ue4ss\Mods\UltrawideFix\
        enabled.txt
        Scripts\main.lua
        Scripts\config.lua

enabled.txt is what switches the mod on. No mods.txt entry is needed.


STEP 5 - Set your resolution
----------------------------
Open ue4ss\Mods\UltrawideFix\Scripts\config.lua and set ScreenWidth / ScreenHeight to
the resolution you play at:

    32:9   5120 x 1440 (default), 3840 x 1080
    21:9   3440 x 1440, 2560 x 1080, 3840 x 1600

Run the game itself at that same native resolution (tested: fullscreen windowed,
5120x1440).


STEP 6 - Play
-------------
Launch the game the usual way. The 16:9 side bars are gone and the view is wider.

The mod is silent: it writes nothing anywhere unless you turn on Debug (see below).
UE4SS itself still writes its own ue4ss\UE4SS.log. Its line
    Mod 'UltrawideFix' has enabled.txt, starting mod.
confirms the mod was found.


CONFIGURATION
-------------
config.lua (save, then restart the game):

    ScreenWidth / ScreenHeight   your resolution; sets the aspect ratio the fix targets
    FovScale                     1.0 = the game's 16:9 vertical view, wider (default)
                                 above 1.0 zooms out further, below 1.0 zooms in (0.5 - 2.0)
    Debug                        false = no logging (default)
                                 true  = log what the mod does to ue4ss\UE4SS.log

If the screen is not wider than 16:9, the mod switches itself off.


UNINSTALL
---------
Remove the fix only:  delete ue4ss\Mods\UltrawideFix
Remove UE4SS too:     delete dwmapi.dll and the ue4ss folder from
                      <game>\FatalClaw\Binaries\Win64\
Nothing else is changed, so the game is back to stock (16:9 with side bars).


TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------
Turn on Debug = true in config.lua first. The mod then writes [UltrawideFix] lines to
ue4ss\UE4SS.log, starting with one that shows the resolution it is using and where its
settings came from. Turn it back off when you are done.

No UE4SS.log at all after launching:
    dwmapi.dll is not next to FatalClaw-Win64-Shipping.exe (STEP 1).

UE4SS.log ends with "PS scan timed out", or mentions the engine version:
    STEP 2 is missing, or the stable v3.0.1 release is installed instead of the
    experimental build.

No "Mod 'UltrawideFix' has enabled.txt" line in UE4SS.log:
    The mod folder is in the wrong place or enabled.txt is missing (STEP 4).

"settings from defaults" in the Debug log, or Debug = true writes nothing:
    config.lua has a typo and could not be read, so the mod is using its built-in
    defaults (5120x1440, Debug off). Every setting line needs a trailing comma.

The picture looks too zoomed in or too zoomed out:
    ScreenWidth / ScreenHeight don't match the resolution the game runs at.

Side bars still there:
    The game is not running at an ultrawide resolution (check its display settings),
    or UE4SS / the mod isn't loading (see above).

See ../notes.md for how the fix works.
